top_apps.description_short: Unscrew, sort the colorful nuts & bolts, and clear every screw. Relax & enjoy!
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Nut Rush is a relaxing sorting puzzle about unscrewing bolts and organizing colored nuts. It is easy to understand, calm to play, and built around one simple idea: bring order to a colorful mess, one move at a time.

WHAT THE GAME IS
Every level shows a small set of bolts, and each bolt is stacked with nuts of different colors all jumbled together. Your job is to move the nuts around so that, by the end, every bolt holds nuts of just one color. Once all the colors are sorted into neat single-color stacks, the level is complete and you move on to the next one.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Tap a bolt to pick up the nut on top of it.
2. Tap another bolt to place that nut down.
3. A nut can only be placed on a bolt whose top nut is the same color, or on an empty bolt.
4. Keep unscrewing and moving nuts until each bolt is a single solid color to clear the board.

The rules take only a few seconds to learn, but solving each board takes a little thought. You will need to plan ahead, keep an empty bolt free as breathing room, and decide the right order to move things so you do not get stuck. Every level has a solution — finding the cleanest path is the fun part.

WHAT THE GAME IS
Every level shows a small set of bolts, and each bolt is stacked with nuts of different colors all jumbled together. The rules take only a few seconds to learn, but solving each board takes a little thought. top_apps.name: Yarnation: Unravel Flow
top_apps.description_short: Unravel knitted patterns with smart yarn sorting puzzles.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Unravel the Threads. Complete the Pattern. Feel the Flow.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a relaxing yet deeply engaging sorting puzzle game where you unravel beautifully knitted artwork using colorful yarn bobbins. Instead of blasting or matching tiles, you carefully remove stitches in the correct order to clear each woven design piece by piece.

Every level feels like solving a handcrafted knitting puzzle.
Every move shapes the flow.
Every unravel delivers a satisfying visual payoff.

If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, color sorting challenges, flow puzzles, and calm strategy-based gameplay, Yarnation: Unravel Flow offers a smooth and rewarding experience that keeps your mind active while staying relaxing.

🧶 A UNIQUE YARN PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Bobbins move along a conveyor system and collect stitches of their own color.
Each bobbin has a limited capacity that decreases as it gathers matching yarn stitches.
